Definition: Pelesheth, the land of the Philistines
BiblicalUsage: Pelesheth is Philistia, the coastal land of the Philistines. At the Red Sea, Moses sang that sorrow would take hold on its inhabitants; Isaiah warns the whole land not to rejoice when the rod that smote it breaks; and Joel asks Tyre and Zidon and all the coasts of Palestine what they have to do with the LORD.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that God speaks to whole nations as He speaks to men: Philistia heard His judgments, and no coast is beyond His word.
